description: Stormwater Projects is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Department of Water Resources. The dataset contains storm water projects planned in the future throughout California that involve groundwater recharge and direct use. It was used to develop storm water targets for the years 2020 and 2035 per directives to DWR in California Water Code Section 10608.50 (b). Projects included are those proposed to be constructed post 2014. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Department of Water Resources. Its tags are california department of water resources. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
